responsibility: Defines the TILEPro RTL operand and operator predicates that machine descriptions use to recognize legal immediates, symbolic forms, TLS references, non-autoincrement memory, call addresses, comparison operators, vector duplicate constants, and move/add/and-specific operand classes. These predicates bridge generic GCC RTL matching with TILEPro-specific encoding and addressing restrictions, and are referenced throughout tilepro.md and related expanders during instruction selection and splitting.
